Are you a hands-on worker who enjoys working in a logistics environment? For our client, an international market leader in food processing solutions, we are looking for a Warehouse Operator for the Manufacturing Warehouse. In this role, you ensure that goods are delivered on time and to the correct location, so the production process continues to run smoothly at all times. Wie zoeken we? What you bring to the team: A completed lower secondary education (VMBO level or equivalent) A minimum of one year of experience working in a warehouse or logistics setting A good command of English — Dutch language skills are a welcome bonus A valid forklift- and reachtruck certificate Wat bieden wij je? What’s in it for you? A competitive monthly salary between €3,210.30 and €3,741.00 gross, based on a 40-hour work week A full-time position in day shifts (07:30 – 16:00), giving you your evenings free A 12-month contract with the possibility of extension based on performance The opportunity to work in an international, fast-paced, and collaborative team A position within a forward-thinking organization that’s driving innovation and sustainability in the global food industry Functieomschrijving Your role as a Warehouse Operator As a Warehouse Operator, you are the driving force behind smooth and efficient warehouse logistics. Every day, you make sure that all incoming and outgoing goods are handled accurately, safely, and on time. From receiving and inspecting materials to delivering them to the right production lines, your precision keeps operations running flawlessly. You’ll also take part in inventory control, prepare shipments, and actively look for ways to make our processes smarter and more efficient. In short: you are the backbone of the warehouse, ensuring that every product and component ends up exactly where it needs to be. Your main responsibilities: Accepting and verifying deliveries, including accompanying documentation Organising and storing materials in the correct

warehouse locations Picking and staging goods for production according to schedule Conducting stock counts and reporting any irregularities Packing, unpacking, and preparing goods for shipment Operating forklifts and reach trucks safely (a valid certificate is required — or can be obtained via SD Worx Jobs) Taking part in continuous improvement initiatives within the warehouse

As an Assembly & Repair Technician, you work in a modern production environment. Together with 6 to 8 colleagues per shift, you make sure technical parts are assembled, checked and prepared for shipment.

Your tasks include:

- Assembling technical parts according to drawings and work instructions
- Repairing and checking plastic, metal and wooden parts
- Packing fragile parts in large crates for international transport
- Carrying out quality checks during and after the work
- Working with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- Reporting defects or deviations to your supervisor
- Keeping your workplace clean and safe

You work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 to 15:00
- Afternoon/evening shift: 15:00 to 00:00

You receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

- For this role, we ask:- You are available full-time for a 2-shift schedule
- You live in the Eindhoven, Veldhoven, Best or Helmond region
- You have experience in technical work, assembly or repair
- You can work with heavier tools, such as a column drill or wall saw
- You can read technical drawings and follow work instructions
- You have a good command of English, both spoken and written
- Experience with accurate and independent working is a plus

As a Logistics Production Operator, you ensure that the inbound and outbound flow of materials within the recycling process runs smoothly. You have a varied role: at times you operate a forklift to move raw materials or finished products, while at other times you support the production process and make sure the machines keep running. In this way, you play a key role in the reuse of PET bottles and other plastics, contributing every day to a more sustainable world.

Your Responsibilities

- Loading, unloading, and moving materials and finished products using a forklift
- Supplying raw materials to machines and replacing filters
- Monitoring inventory and maintaining an orderly warehouse and site
- Ensuring a safe, clean, and well-organized working environment
- Liaising with the Technical Department in case of malfunctions or technical issues

What We Ask

- A practical and flexible work attitude
- Experience in production or logistics is a plus
- Forklift certificate or willingness to obtain one
- A team player with a strong focus on safety and quality

You will work in a fixed 10-day shift rotation:

- 2 days early shift (06:00 – 14:00)
- 2 days late shift (14:00 – 22:00)
- 2 days night shift (22:00 – 06:00)

After this, you have 4 days off before the cycle starts again.

Job Requirements

- Forklift certificate or driving license (no certificate yet? You can obtain one through us)
- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Hands-on mentality with a strong focus on results
- Team spirit and willingness to work together
- Safety-conscious and responsible working attitude
- Flexible and willing to work in a 5-shift system and take on various tasks

For HQ Pack in Eindhoven, we are looking for technical and accurate employees who want to work in a cleanroom environment. Together with your colleagues, you will assemble and process high-tech products for international customers.

Your tasks include:

- Collecting products and processing data in the ERP system
- Assembling products based on technical drawings and work instructions
- Working with hand tools such as screwdrivers and assembly tools
- Cleaning, inspecting, and packaging high-tech components according to cleanroom guidelines
- Performing quality checks and verifying product specifications
- Identifying and reporting deviations during the production process
- Keeping the cleanroom and workplace clean and safe

You will work full-time in a 2-shift schedule:

- Morning shift: 06:00 – 15:00
- Evening shift: 15:00 – 00:00

You will receive an 18% shift allowance for working in shifts.

Must-haves

- vmbo/mbo working and thinking level
- Ability to read technical drawings
- Good command of the English language
- Willingness to work in a 2-shift schedule
- Accurate and structured working attitude

Preferred

- Experience in assembly, production, or cleanroom work
- Experience working with hand tools and technical assembly

What your workdays will look like in this role:You’ll be working Monday to Friday in a 2-shift schedule:06:00 – 15:00 and 15:00 – 00:00.

The cleanroom is a highly controlled, sterile environment designed to minimize – and ideally eliminate – contamination during production or research processes. Contaminants can include dust, fibers, airborne microorganisms, fine particles, or chemical vapors. You’ll be responsible for cleaning metal frames and components that are used in industries such as microchip manufacturing. Together with your colleagues, you will also clean all related packaging materials to ensure they meet the highest cleanliness standards required for use in cleanroom environments.

In this position you work in a production environment. Of course you also check the products. In addition, your daily work as a Cleanroom Operator consists of:

- Cleaning high-tech (technical parts) parts according to instructions and protocols
- Carrying out assembly and cleaning work
- Carrying out quality measurements
- Working on the basis of instructions and drawings (Powerpoint)

To be successful in this position, you preferably already have some technical insight / technical experience in a Cleanroom or any other production environment.

You bring commitment and enthusiasm to your work and identify with the following qualities:

- Positive mindset
- Stress-resistant and responsible
- Proactive and involved team player
- Helpful, quality-focused, and safety-oriented

Additionally, you:

- Have a good command of the English language, as all safety protocols, work instructions, and team communication are in English
- Work in a structured and independent manner
- Can read technical drawings and follow detailed work instructions accurately
- Living in the area of Eindhoven, Helmond, Veldhoven or Valkenswaard

- Internal training opportunities
- Full-time, and part-time options
- Bring a friend and get € 200!

Who you are
As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn, you are customer-friendly. Lifting heavy crates up to 15 kilos is no problem for you! What else you need to know about this job:

- You speak Dutch or English;

After delivering the groceries at the doorstep, you handle the payment with your mobile payment device. Did you deliver everything on time? Nice! Then it’s time to return to your colleagues at the distribution center. Ready for a new day!
